description: Lime Stuttgart is a shared-mobility system listed in the GBFS registry used by Mobility Database. Its listed geographic coverage is Stuttgart, country code DE. The MobilityData registry listed System ID lime_stuttgart and GBFS version 3.0. The official MobiData BW change log records that this system was renamed lime_bw and that the renamed feed includes Stuttgart and Konstanz. The current GBFS v3 auto-discovery endpoint returns HTTP 200 and links to published components. Its system_information metadata identifies Lime as operator. This metadata does not establish current vehicle availability or feed completeness. The registry does not state feed-use charges; the licence field retains any provider declaration found in system-information metadata. Station and vehicle data were not downloaded, and current operation or completeness is not established by a registry listing. The resource can provide shared-mobility supply inputs for transport accessibility, network and capacity studies when the relevant components are available. The related Mobility Database catalogue record documents the discovery source.
